Home / Loading-States / Error State

Error State

Communicates that something went wrong and provides recovery actions.

Error with Icon

A simple error display with an icon.

Something went wrong

An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

HTML
<div class="zak-error-state">
    <div class="zak-error-state-icon">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5">
            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
            <line x1="15" y1="9" x2="9" y2="15"/>
            <line x1="9" y1="9" x2="15" y2="15"/>
        </svg>
    </div>
    <h3 class="zak-error-state-title">Something went wrong</h3>
    <p class="zak-error-state-text">An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.</p>
</div>

Error with Title and Description

Detailed error information with a description.

Failed to load data

The server returned an error while fetching your dashboard data. This might be due to a temporary issue.

Error: 500 Internal Server Error

HTML
<div class="zak-error-state">
    <div class="zak-error-state-icon zak-error-state-icon-warning">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5">
            <path d="M10.29 3.86L1.82 18a2 2 0 001.71 3h16.94a2 2 0 001.71-3L13.71 3.86a2 2 0 00-3.42 0z"/>
            <line x1="12" y1="9" x2="12" y2="13"/><line x1="12" y1="17" x2="12.01" y2="17"/>
        </svg>
    </div>
    <h3 class="zak-error-state-title">Failed to load data</h3>
    <p class="zak-error-state-text">The server returned an error while fetching your dashboard data.</p>
    <p class="zak-error-state-code">Error: 500 Internal Server Error</p>
</div>

Error with Retry Button

Include a retry button to let users attempt recovery.

Connection lost

Unable to connect to the server. Check your internet connection and try again.

HTML
<div class="zak-error-state">
    <div class="zak-error-state-icon">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5">
            <path d="M23 4v6h-6"/>
            <path d="M20.49 15a9 9 0 11-2.12-9.36L23 10"/>
        </svg>
    </div>
    <h3 class="zak-error-state-title">Connection lost</h3>
    <p class="zak-error-state-text">Unable to connect to the server.</p>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary">Retry</button>
</div>

404 Error

Page not found error state.

404

Page not found

The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.

HTML
<div class="zak-error-state">
    <div class="zak-error-state-code-large">404</div>
    <h3 class="zak-error-state-title">Page not found</h3>
    <p class="zak-error-state-text">The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has been moved.</p>
    <div class="zak-error-state-actions">
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary">Go Home</button>
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline">Contact Support</button>
    </div>
</div>

500 Error

Server error state.

500

Server error

Something went wrong on our end. Our team has been notified and is working on a fix.

HTML
<div class="zak-error-state">
    <div class="zak-error-state-code-large">500</div>
    <h3 class="zak-error-state-title">Server error</h3>
    <p class="zak-error-state-text">Something went wrong on our end.</p>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary">Try Again</button>
</div>

Network Error

Network connectivity error state.

Network error

Could not connect to the network. Please check your internet connection and try again.

HTML
<div class="zak-error-state">
    <div class="zak-error-state-icon">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5">
            <line x1="1" y1="1" x2="23" y2="23"/>
            <path d="M16.72 11.06A10.94 10.94 0 0119 12.55"/>
            <path d="M5 12.55a10.94 10.94 0 015.17-2.39"/>
            <path d="M10.71 5.05A16 16 0 0122.56 9"/>
            <path d="M1.42 9a15.91 15.91 0 014.7-2.88"/>
            <path d="M8.53 16.11a6 6 0 016.95 0"/>
            <line x1="12" y1="20" x2="12.01" y2="20"/>
        </svg>
    </div>
    <h3 class="zak-error-state-title">Network error</h3>
    <p class="zak-error-state-text">Could not connect to the network.</p>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary">Check Connection</button>
</div>

Error with Illustration

Decorative illustration alongside error messaging.

Upload failed

Your file couldn't be uploaded. Make sure the file is under 10MB and in a supported format.

HTML
<div class="zak-error-state">
    <div class="zak-error-state-illustration">
        <div style="width:120px;height:120px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--zak-danger-light),var(--zak-warning-light));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="var(--zak-danger)" stroke-width="1.5">
                <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
                <line x1="15" y1="9" x2="9" y2="15"/><line x1="9" y1="9" x2="15" y2="15"/>
            </svg>
        </div>
    </div>
    <h3 class="zak-error-state-title">Upload failed</h3>
    <p class="zak-error-state-text">Your file couldn't be uploaded.</p>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary">Try Again</button>
</div>
